The decisive mistake was the annual pass pricing that Tickets_Pricing_Expert reported at step 3. It presented the figures ($90 per adult, $75 for the age 3-5 child) as "recent" without any source. Those prices produced the negative savings (-$23) that every later agent accepted. The arithmetic in the downstream steps was correct, but it was applied to unverified inputs. Verification_Expert checked only the multiplication and addition, not the prices themselves, so the error went uncaught. The expected answer of 45 implies the annual pass cost was different from what was reported.
